authority: Operator instruction (in-session): debug the n08c_implementation_drafting failure of run e93b54c6-173a-4fe1-84cf-ab18741a92f2. Logged per §9.4. Transport-layer change only (§17.5.2 / §17.1.3); no workflow logic, gate logic, artifact schema, or skill semantics altered.

problem.symptom: Run e93b54c6 n08c_implementation_drafting failed with failure_origin='agent_body', failure_category='SKILL_FAILURE': decomposed drafter response for sub-section '3.1' contained no parseable JSON object (41,380 chars, captured at .claude/logs/decomposed_drafting/e93b54c6-.../implementation/3.1.response.txt).
problem.diagnosis: The captured response is FRONT-TRUNCATED: it begins mid-word inside the JSON string ('...WP' | '5 covers...' — a token-boundary cut signature) and ends with a structurally valid JSON tail. The fail-closed rejection by _extract_json_response / _parse_drafter_response was CORRECT behaviour (§17.6.5, §12.4); the defect is upstream in the transport.
problem.root_cause: claude -p in its default text output mode prints only the FINAL assistant message of the session. The '3.1' generation spanned more than one assistant turn (an output-token cut at the CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=32000 per-turn ceiling that the CLI auto-continued; a mid-answer tool call produces the same shape). Every earlier turn's text was dropped, so the transport delivered only the tail of the JSON object.
problem.class_history: Third recurrence of the front-truncation class: (1) 2026-07-14 concept-alignment-check (mitigated by raising the output-token ceiling to 32000, decision runtime-truncation-fix); (2) 2026-07-29 run a79ed11e n08a (mitigated by rejecting interior fragments in _extract_json_response and by restoring leaf-granularity drafting); (3) 2026-07-30 run e93b54c6 n08c '3.1'. Each prior fix treated a symptom (ceiling height, parser fail-open, draft size); the structural defect — the transport discarding all non-final assistant turns — remained.
problem.trigger_context: The '3.1' redraft ran fresh (not reused) because the 2026-07-29 §3b task-citation edit to implementation-section-drafting.md correctly invalidated n08c's reuse fingerprint. The redraft's cut/continue turn split is model-run variance; the prior run d20b6c0c produced a 48.7K-char '3.1' in a single turn that parsed fine.

fix_applied.change: invoke_claude_text now invokes claude -p with '--output-format stream-json --verbose' and reassembles the response with a new pure helper _reassemble_stream_json: the text blocks of ALL top-level assistant events (parent_tool_use_id null; thinking/tool_use blocks and sub-agent traffic excluded) are concatenated in emission order with NO separator, so a turn split mid-token rejoins seamlessly. Fallback: stdout with no recognizable stream-json events is returned verbatim (keeps the transport usable against a CLI/test double that ignores the flag). Fail-closed: stream-json output with no assistant text raises ClaudeTransportError. Rate-limit detection (ClaudeCLIRateLimitError) still scans raw stdout/stderr and is unaffected.
fix_applied.constitutional_class: Transport layer only (§17.5.2). Reassembly is faithful capture of what the model actually emitted across the CLI's message stream — no repair, no synthesis, no reordering — so §17.6.5 (no silent repair) is untouched: a genuinely malformed response still fails downstream parsing and is reported honestly. All runtime contracts (§17.4), gate logic, and failure semantics unchanged.
fix_applied.regression_guard: tests/runner/test_claude_transport.py::TestStreamJsonReassembly (9 tests): multi-turn mid-token rejoin round-trips through json.loads; result-event text not duplicated; thinking/tool_use/sub-agent blocks excluded; plain-text fallback preserved; no-assistant-text fails closed; malformed JSONL lines ignored. Live smoke through the real claude CLI 2.1.200 confirmed stream-json event shape and clean reassembly.
